metadata.title: Lo-Fi Flash Portrait with Graphic Makeup

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered, low-angle portrait of a person with a high-contrast flash effect, featuring stylized graphic eyelashes, a silver tooth grill, and a thick braid, all set against a grainy, desaturated lavender background.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up framing focusing on facial features and hair texture
High-intensity flash creating harsh highlights and deep shadows
Contrast between organic hair braids and artificial graphic makeup elements
Muted, cool-toned background vs. warm skin tones
coreInvariants: Visible film grain and digital noise
Silver dental accessory on front teeth
Large, textured braid framing the left side of the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered face occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the graphic eyelashes.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the mouth/grill, then follows the large braid upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, limited to the grainy lavender corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm, highlighted skin tones with yellow undertones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and blue graphic eyelashes; silver tooth grill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high-value highlights from the flash.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in a modular block.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, blocky feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides a cleaner, more modern grotesque look with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, lo-fi flash portrait of a person with a large thick braid on one side, wearing graphic red and blue spiky eyelashes and a silver tooth grill, against a muted lavender wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, rectangular 'Parental Advisory' style text block in the bottom right corner using a white condensed sans-serif font on a black background.

verificationChecks: Are the eyelashes stylized and graphic rather than natural?
Is the lighting harsh, simulating a direct camera flash?
Is the text block positioned in the bottom right corner?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist logos
Do not replicate the exact facial features of a specific celebrity
Ensure the text is generic advisory wording

mustAchieve: High-contrast flash highlights on the nose and forehead
Sharp focus on the graphic makeup

postGenerationChecks: Check for harsh flash shadows behind the subject
Ensure the silver grill has a metallic sheen
Verify the braid texture is distinct and chunky
Confirm the text block is legible but small
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject with Graphic Makeup] + [Harsh Flash Lighting] + [Grainy Lo-Fi Filter] + [Bottom-Right Block Typography].
